run_boost_default_build_test: run the Boost.Build test script that verifies default build clause behavior for debug and release variants
test_default_build_suppression: test that an explicitly-specified build variant suppresses the default build settings in Boost.Build
test_default_build_combination: test that explicit build requests combine with default build settings in Boost.Build
test_default_build_conflict_detection: test that Boost.Build detects and errors when default build clauses differ across alternatives
test_default_build_define_propagation: test that default build defines propagate correctly across sub-projects in Boost.Build
